description: Spend a claim token to move an anonymous artifact into the key's workspace. A Pro or Business workspace keeps it; a free one restamps a fresh 24-hour expiry. Pass `run` to also group it under a run — an anonymous upload could not name one, so this is the only way it gets one. Needs an API key.

claim_token.description: The claim token the anonymous push returned, e.g. krowk_claim_...

run.description: Run to attach the claimed upload to, e.g. run_..., or any link carrying it. Attached after the claim, so it must be a run in this key's workspace.

slug.description: Artifact slug, e.g. art_9f3c2e1a7b04d6c8e5f1a2b3 — or any link carrying it, like https://gruntas.com/a/art_9f3c2e1a7b04d6c8e5f1a2b3.

name: gruntas_claim_artifact
